column3: WebDriver stack: automation opt-in, attach, split adoption, trusted input, live GitHub CSP run (needs WebKitWebDriver + shim build; GitHub leg skips offline)
Navigation barrier: goto/back/forward/reload never let a following eval read the previous document; wait-flag chaining, honest timeouts
Popup routing: window.open and target=_blank land in panes, window.opener survives, burst budget holds
cmux search across panes: both pane kinds, --kind/--regex/--case-sensitive, innerText semantics, JSON refs
Find-in-page: counts, next/previous wrap, case sensitivity, no-match recovery
Session schema v3 round-trip: tabs, selection, browser URLs/history, scrollback replay, background workspaces across restart
Pane zoom: geometry, toggle, switching panes, not persisted
Address bar via xdotool: typed loopback/domain/search resolution mirrors navigation
Browser profiles: per-profile cookie/storage isolation verbs
VTE backend scrollback capture + replay across an instance restart
Settings precedence (env > file > default), preferences verbs
UI/protocol verbs: tree, tab actions, notifications, move/reorder, swap/resize/break/join, debug.surfaces
Ephemeral browser panes: --profile ephemeral opens a fresh in-memory session that persists no cookies/storage/cache and dies with the pane; isolation vs a persistent profile, reserved-name guards
Sibling team launchers (codex-teams/omc/omx/omo) shim+env setup on Linux; real agent splits skipped (binaries absent), launcher path verified
workspace.group.* family: create/membership/contiguity/pin tier/anchor semantics/dissolution/persistence round-trip/error surfaces; new-workspace --group create path

Minimal Dock: global dock.json seeds terminal controls into the trailing panel; lazy populate on first show, login-shell command execution (marker), browser controls skipped+counted, debug.dock projection + toggle
swap-shim.sh: rename-not-overwrite (old inode survives under the backup name), dropped-export and unloadable-shim refusals, --force override, rollback, unattended guard — fake libs, no instance

WebAuthn client layer + software authenticator: flag gating, API surface, create/get ceremonies, vault 0600, excludeCredentials, RP-grade ES256 verification (needs python3-cryptography for the signature leg); P1b vault encryption: ciphertext-at-rest, v1 migration with .v1.bak, no-backend plaintext fallback with logged warning
